messages.text: ¡Hola! ¿Qué te gustaría ordenar hoy? Tenemos café recién hecho y pastelería deliciosa.
messages.translation: Hi! What would you like to order today? We have freshly brewed coffee and delicious pastries.

messages.text: Quisiera un café con leche y un croissant, por favor.
messages.grammarTip: Perfect sentence! You used "quisiera" (I would like) which is very polite for ordering.

messages.text: Excelente elección. ¿Deseas el café grande o mediano?
messages.translation: Excellent choice. Do you want the coffee large or medium?
